title.zh: 原子双通道散射源归约

summary: The pointwise sum Beta_CX + OmegaM of the atomic charge-exchange and elastic scattered-generation normalized spatial source distributions (Q/Vth, in F/m) on one velocity-space mesh, preserving signed values.

capability: The pointwise sum Beta_CX + OmegaM of the atomic charge-exchange and elastic scattered-generation normalized spatial source distributions (Q/Vth, in F/m) on one velocity-space mesh, preserving signed values.
operation: sum the atomic scattered-generation source channels
two aligned source fields -> their pointwise sum
discovery.model: Pointwise aggregation of the two scattered-generation source channels; normalized spatial transport with u=v/Vth and inverse-length collision coefficients
discovery.geometry: two velocity dimensions over one spatial axis; velocity axes are dimensionless u=v/Vth on one common caller normalization
discovery.boundary: two finite aligned three-dimensional fields; signed values preserved

identity.relation: Beta = Beta_CX + OmegaM pointwise on one (nvr,nvx,nx) mesh
identity.direction: two aligned source fields -> their pointwise sum
identity.definition: Plain pointwise addition; no clamping of signed values
identity.model: Pointwise aggregation of the two scattered-generation source channels
identity.geometry: two velocity dimensions over one spatial axis
identity.coordinates: All input and output source fields are Q/Vth in F/m (m^-4 when F is m^-3), on one common dimensionless u=v/Vth velocity grid.
identity.boundary: two finite aligned three-dimensional fields; signed values preserved
assumptions: The caller owns the construction of each channel's source; this asset only aggregates.
Signed entries are meaningful (the channel normalizations may subtract); the sum does not clamp.

Declared finiteness tightening: the output is gated for finiteness, so extreme-but-valid inputs that would overflow fail closed rather than returning non-finite results, per the finite-output contract. The divergence is pinned by a bounded regression test.

The public transport convention is u=v/Vth on one caller-selected thermal-speed scale: alpha=nu/Vth has units m^-1, F integrates over normalized velocity volume to number density in m^-3, and every spatial source coefficient is Q/Vth in F/m. Physical rates in s^-1 must be divided by that same Vth before this spatial operator; no automatic conversion is performed.

inputs.name: charge_exchange_source_distribution
inputs.constraints: A finite three-dimensional field; signed values preserved.

inputs.name: elastic_source_distribution
inputs.constraints: A finite three-dimensional field aligned to the CX field; signed values preserved.

outputs.name: total_source
outputs.constraints: The pointwise sum; finite; signed values preserved.

preconditions: Use one common Vth for normalized velocity nodes, inverse-length collision coefficients and spatial source coefficients; the callable performs no implicit unit conversion.
supported: Atomic generation-source aggregation on a shared mesh.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for non-real/boolean/string/complex or nonfinite source values, or when the two sources are not aligned 3-D arrays.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Raises ValueError when the pointwise sum is not finite; no clipping or fallback is applied.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; the reduction is a direct pointwise sum.
failure_semantics.partial_results: Never returned; a rejected call produces no partial array.

example.description: Aggregate two atomic sources, including a cancellation case, and reject misalignment.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.kinetic import reduce_atomic_scattered_sources
source = np.ones((1, 2, 3))
np.testing.assert_allclose(reduce_atomic_scattered_sources(source, 2 * source), 3 * source)
np.testing.assert_allclose(reduce_atomic_scattered_sources(source, -source), np.zeros_like(source))
try:
    reduce_atomic_scattered_sources(source, np.ones((1, 2, 4)))
except ValueError as error:
    assert 'finite aligned 3-D' in str(error)
else:
    raise AssertionError('a misaligned field must be rejected')
example.expected: Observed PASS: The pointwise sums including exact cancellation; a misaligned field is rejected.

scope: Direct tests bind signed pointwise sums, cancellation, shape validation, implicit-real rejection and overflowing-total rejection.
The cross-domain tests consume real CX and elastic source producers and compare their aggregated physical RHS and velocity-integrated number balance.
The contract example covers one bounded representative call; numerical checks do not establish external physical validation or full-domain applicability.
